sentences.en: I'm so happy right now.
sentences.zh: 我現在好開心。

sentences.en: I feel a bit sad today.
sentences.zh: 我今天有點難過。

sentences.en: I'm really frustrated with this situation.
sentences.zh: 我對這個情況感到很沮喪。

sentences.en: I'm so excited about the trip!
sentences.zh: 我對這趟旅行超興奮的！

sentences.en: I'm worried about the exam.
sentences.zh: 我擔心考試。

sentences.en: What a relief!
sentences.zh: 真是鬆了一口氣！

sentences.en: I feel overwhelmed by all this work.
sentences.zh: 這些工作量讓我感到喘不過氣。

sentences.en: I'm grateful for your support.
sentences.zh: 我很感激你的支持。

sentences.en: I feel lonely sometimes.
sentences.zh: 我有時候覺得很孤單。

sentences.en: I'm disappointed with the results.
sentences.zh: 我對結果感到失望。

sentences.en: I feel anxious about the interview.
sentences.zh: 我對面試感到焦慮。

sentences.en: I'm proud of what I've accomplished.
sentences.zh: 我為自己的成就感到驕傲。

sentences.en: I'm feeling under the weather today.
sentences.zh: 我今天覺得不太舒服。

sentences.en: That really hurt my feelings.
sentences.zh: 那真的傷了我的心。

sentences.en: I'm feeling much better now.
sentences.zh: 我現在感覺好多了。

sentences.en: I'm nervous about the presentation.
sentences.zh: 我對這個報告感到緊張。

sentences.en: I feel inspired after hearing your story.
sentences.zh: 聽了你的故事我感到很受啟發。

sentences.en: I'm angry about what happened.
sentences.zh: 我對發生的事感到生氣。

sentences.en: I feel confused about what to do next.
sentences.zh: 我對接下來該怎麼做感到困惑。

sentences.en: I'm feeling a bit homesick.
sentences.zh: 我有點想家。

sentences.en: I feel embarrassed about my mistake.
sentences.zh: 我對自己的錯誤感到尷尬。

sentences.en: I'm thrilled to hear the good news!
sentences.zh: 聽到好消息我超開心的！

sentences.en: I feel stressed out lately.
sentences.zh: 我最近壓力很大。

sentences.en: I'm content with my life right now.
sentences.zh: 我對現在的生活很滿足。

sentences.en: I feel jealous when I see that.
sentences.zh: 看到那個我覺得有點嫉妒。

sentences.en: I'm scared of what might happen.
sentences.zh: 我害怕可能會發生的事。

sentences.en: I feel hopeful about the future.
sentences.zh: 我對未來充滿希望。

sentences.en: I'm bored. Let's do something fun.
sentences.zh: 我好無聊，我們做點好玩的吧。

sentences.en: I feel appreciated when you say that.
sentences.zh: 你那樣說讓我覺得被重視。

sentences.en: I'm exhausted after today.
sentences.zh: 今天過後我精疲力盡。
